item.title: Counter-Strike 2 Update
item.description:
\[ MAPS ]

Cobblestone

  • Fixed some walkable ledges in long A

  • Fixed map issue that was loading an empty skybox

  • Fixed an audio blocker issue by mid/A

  • Added a grenade clip to assault van bumper

  • Fixed various gaps in the world

Inferno

  • Fixed grenade and Molotov exploit spot from church to dark on bombsite B.

\[ MISC ]

  • Updated slow reload animation for the AWP

  • Optimized ground burn decals under smoke on very high graphics settings

\[ X-RAY SCANNER ]

  • Players in Switzerland will have an X-Ray Scanner tab in their Inventory. For those players, containers can only be opened via X-Ray Scanner. The X-Ray Scanner will come preloaded with a one-time exclusive non-tradable "Genuine P250 | X-Ray", which must be claimed before using the X-Ray Scanner to reveal items in other containers.

item.title: Counter-Strike 2 Update
item.description:
[ SINGAPORE 2026 MAJOR ]
  • The PGL Singapore 2026 Major Hub is now available. Visit the hub to purchase tournament items, play the Pick'Em Challenge, and more.
  • Purchase a Singapore 2026 Viewer Pass to receive an upgradable Singapore 2026 Coin. With an active pass, you can upgrade your coin and earn rewards by playing the Pick'Em Challenge. Additionally, you will show up on the Active Pass Leaderboard where you can compare your Pick'Em Challenge performance to your friends.
[ MAPS ]
  • Added Cobblestone map to official Casual, Competitive, Wingman, Retakes, and Deathmatch matchmaking.
  • Removed Boulder, Fachwerk, and Shelter from official matchmaking pool.
[ MUSIC ]
  • Added 8 new music kits from Monstercat.
[ ANIMATION ]
  • Fixed head dipping too low at extreme aim angles.
  • Restored T-side lowered aim pose.
[ MISC ]
  • Fixed a case of defuse kits not getting correctly granted in Retakes.
  • Fixed T-side bots to attack CTs who try to defuse the bomb.
  • Added custom processing for fire effects on ground materials to apply hardening to metal surfaces, to melt snow, and so on.
  • Added "health_c4_preview" output value in player_state objects for Game State Integration.
  • Added MVP Anthem preview button when inspecting Music Kits in the in-game store.

item.title: The Cobbled Road to Singapore
item.description:
Today's update features the return of a legendary map. Welcome back, Cobblestone!

Cobblestone veterans will feel at home in familiar locations like drop, chicken coop, and stables. But don't get cold feet, the map has undergone changes and features new pathways and locations for players to master. And it's cold now, so watch your crunchy footsteps as you trudge through the snow to the bombsites.

Cobblestone can be found in Competitive, Wingman, and in its own map group in Casual, Deathmatch, and Retakes.

PGL Major Singapore 2026 Tournament Items

The Singapore 2026 Major is right around the corner, which means it's time for Tournament items! Major Viewer Passes and Team and Player Autograph stickers are now available for purchase in the Major Shop! As before, 50% of the proceeds go to the players, teams and tournament organizer, with revenue shared based on a team's initial seed and final placement.


We've heard your feedback and made some adjustments. Team and Player Autograph stickers are available in Paper, Foil, Holo, and Gold finishes for a fixed price and can be purchased directly. Souvenirs are craftable for a fixed price as well based on the rarity of the weapon you choose.


Purchase and activate a Singapore 2026 Viewer Pass to immediately receive a Bronze Singapore Challenge Coin, Steam.tv chat flair, and unlimited team graffiti for the duration of the event. Upgrade your coin by making picks in the Pick'Em Challenge. Every time you upgrade your coin you'll earn 300 tokens that you can spend on the stickers or souvenirs of your choice.

Why stop at Silver when a Diamond Challenge Coin is just a few picks away?



Monstercat Music Kits

And there's more! Today we are excited to release 8 new music kits from Monstercat.

Whether it's a classic Monstercat release from Tristam & Braken or an April Fool's joke gone viral from Noisestorm, there's an offering for everyone!

Now put on a jacket and get out there. We'll see you in the snow!

item.title: Counter-Strike 2 Update
item.description:
\[ GAMEPLAY ]

  • Bomb defusal in Retakes mode will now instantly finish when there is sufficient time remaining in the round and no active utility remains to prevent the defuse.

  • Reduced freeze time and round restart delay in Retakes mode.

  • Pinging pet chickens during freeze time will request a trick from them.

  • Pet chicken names are no longer displayed when customized item text game option is set to hidden.

\[ MAP SCRIPTING ]

  • Instance.Precache now accepts entities to precache

  • Added new top level export Entities

  • Added Entities.Spawn

  • Added Instance.OnBotControl

  • Added CSPlayerController.IsControllingBot

  • Added CSPlayerController.GetControlledBotPawn

  • Added CSPlayerPawn.Reset

  • Moved Instance.ConnectOutput to Entities and changed it to accept a config object

  • Moved Instance.DisconnectOutput to Entities

  • Renamed Instance.EntFireAtName to Entities.FireInput

  • Renamed Instance.FindEntitiesByName to Entities.FindByName

  • Renamed Instance.FindEntitiesByClass to Entities.FindByClass

  • Renamed Instance.EntFireAtTarget to Entity.FireInput

  • Moved and renamed methods are still available in their original location, deprecated

  • Deprecated Instance.FindEntityByName and FindEntityByClass

  • Calling a method on an invalid (removed) Entity now reports that the Entity is invalid

  • ConnectOutput now logs a warning when the target has no output with that name
